why: Rosetta: Scientific Data PDF of the article also in the corpus as JATS (epmc-s41597-024-04291-z), publisher HTML, and Grobid TEI. The abstract is an unlabeled bold paragraph; OPEN and DATA DESCRIPTOR labels sit beside the title in another size; Methods subsections are bold run-in labels (Sampling locations.); affiliations are footnotes at the foot of page 1. JATS counts 60 references because Europe PMC repeats three data citations; the PDF lists 57. Four headings open with a bold initial the font maps to a lowercase letter (t, then echnical Validation); each gets its capital back. pdf.js reports the 9 pt run after QIAamp's raised ® at the ®'s 16 pt; it neither sets its row's baseline nor its line's size, so the next line stays apart and no heading appears.
